title: 10 Dark-Terminal Feature Clips Got a Bright Makeover | vitalii.no
description:
A new bright visual template only proves itself once it's used on real content, not just a single demo composition. Ten of the platform's oldest feature clips - covering comment replies, content rewriting, duplicate detection, image prompts, job analysis, multi-LLM routing, pre-moderation, social teasers, the video factory and the visual director - were still running the original dark schema and needed to validate the new design before it could be trusted for the rest of the catalog.

All 10 compositions were rewritten from the dark schema to the bright v2 template in one batch, using Claude subagents in parallel to split the work. Each clip was re-rendered, verified and uploaded to Cloudflare R2 under its exact original storage key, so the live site picked up the new look with zero broken links and no manual redeploy.

All 10 were queued for a slow LinkedIn repost instead of flooding the feed at once - one clip a day, starting 17:00 UTC on August 22nd, so each gets its second appearance spread out over 10 days.
